coverage.method: All 4,441 primary AZ/EN rows screened. All 2,557 exact print matches compared in compact excerpts. All 1,064 additional cached-source rows actually compared in sequential batches (current primary AZ/EN against cached edition glosses; native summary where present). Doubtful entries received fuller endpoint/source or web checks. Source-compared means inspected, not independently proven correct; scope is primary gloss and identified secondary senses, not full native-speaker verification of every secondary sense.
coverage.secondary_sense_policy: All 625 entries and all 1,021 displayed extra AZ/EN pairs were read against available cached source glosses. Clear mistranslations, grammatical direction, false friends, literal idioms and omitted sense registers were corrected via sensePairs, preserving existing primary meanings and valid polysemy. Scoped-register questions received full original English senses/tags/examples and print checks; select ambiguous facts received web corroboration. One uncorroborated load-horse secondary sense remains explicitly held. This is complete secondary screening and available-source comparison, not native-speaker certification of every source assertion.
